normal.text: Played Perfect Dark. Maybe I will do a detailed writeup of it and GoldenEye someday. So far, like the setting, soundtrack, level design and atmosphere far more than Goldeneye. Hard to believe they achieved this on the 64, shows how much the low inbuilt memory hampered the console. I completed all 3 parts of M1: DataDyne, stopped playing after that because am not sure if clunker 4460 overheating makes the game lag or if it has such bad performance naturally, probably both. #gaming #retrogaming

normal.name: robavince
normal.text: One of my favorite misunderstood RPGs is technically the sequel, although it has almost zero relation vis a vis narrative and plot. D2 on #Dreamcast is a role playing game often described as a survival horror. It's a survival horror if combat were random encounters and you had HP and were in a sandbox. The voice acting is bad, but the atmosphere shines. You're stranded after a plane crash in the frozen wilderness. There are mutants. Don't die. A great game for #Halloween! #retrogaming

normal.name: robavince
normal.text: Here's one of my retro favorite games to play for the spooky #Halloween season. Often called a survival horror, it's not. This is an adventure game on rails with prerendered 3D graphics. The atmosphere here is where the game shines. You're transported... somewhere... and you gotta get out. The game's designed to be played in a single sitting, like a film, and it's also only 2 hours or less. Although the Saturn version is pictured, it's also on DOS, PSX, and 3DO. #retrogaming

normal.text: CityLab on the #C64 now has planes, but their are a few rules however! The players airport must be powered and the city must have achieved 'city' level status. Also, it is wise to build airports further apart. Airports close together may compete for business, so one may be completely inactive. Having an airport improves your mayoral rating and keeps the population and industry happy. However, it also add to the pollution level. It's all a balancing act! @c64 @EC64 #Commodore #retrogaming #retrogames #8bit #simulation

normal.name: Travis Briggs
normal.text: TIL that vanilla DOOM monsters don't pathfind. They come directly at the player. ALSO If a monster is in a corner between a wall and a door that it is allowed to activate, it uses its "turn" to try to open the door instead of move off the wall. Which means that you can pin a monster like an imp or a caco to the jamb of a door, and just execute it. 💀 #doom #retrogaming
